quote: items={['Global budget growth cap: GDP + 0.5%', 'Shared savings: up to 50% retained by CCO', 'Downside risk introduced at CCO scale ≥100K members', 'Quality withhold: 3.5% of capitation at risk']} />
correct_fact: Oregon's CCO global budget growth cap is 3.4% per member per year (sustainable rate of growth tied to the state cost growth target), not GDP+0.5%. CCOs are fully capitated, at full risk from day one, with no shared-savings split or 100K-member downside threshold. The quality incentive is an add-on Quality Pool (4.25% of total PMPM in 2022-2024, $325M in 2024), not a 3.5% withhold. CCO 2.0 also set a goal of 70% of CCO provider payments being value-based by the end of the contract period.
source_quote: Bonuses are on top of monthly payments that cover the cost of care ... 2024 | $325 | 4.25%; (legislative doc) to not grow more than 3.4 percent per capita annually; (CCO 2.0 report) 70 percent of their payments to providers be VBPs by the end of the five-year period

quote: PMPM growth rate tied to state economic growth plus equity adjustment factors.
correct_fact: CCO global budgets may grow at no more than 3.4% per member per year (the sustainable rate of growth), aligned with Oregon's cost growth target.
source_quote: budget can grow at no more than 3.4 percent per member per year
